status: Qualified transparent-compatibility phase of strict-functor wrapper retirement, with required default Hom computation restored at native owners. Final compatibility-name/helper retirement and production qualification remain open.
contracts: StrictFunctor, make_strict_functor, strict_functor and strict_functor_underlying are transparent compatibility aliases of public Functor/maps. No separate opaque object grammar or mandatory runtime discriminator remains.

StrictFunctor_cat aliases Functor_cat because their complete Homs agree; the inclusion is its identity functor. GrayHom_lax keeps its distinct LaxTransfor Homs. StrictTransfor and StrictFunctord remain genuine separate profiles.
identity_is_strict is now derived through the existing compositor proof instead of supplied as a constant. The native IsStrictFunctor property/extraction machinery remains available.
Groupoidal fibre transport and its reviewer take ordinary Cat-valued Functor inputs directly, with the same mapped inverse data. No Cat_cart-family admission is imposed on that ordinary diagram API.
The ring-presheaf strict facade aliases the existing ordinary category/carrier, the one-category admission adapter returns F directly, and the named walking reviewer uses Functor_cat.

Twenty-four wrapper-profile rule commands are removed, but their necessary Hom computations are preserved at the default owners. Five existing identity-only composition/reassociation rules are generalized, and two mapped-arrow cases are restored.

Whole postcomposition accumulates; its capped composite expands to consecutive represented cuts. Base composites already expressed by identity-family postcomposition have the same nested form. This preserves actual DefIso cancellation and avoids installing the opposite nested-to-composite fold that would loop with the existing identity presentation.

Precomposition retains its composite-base normal form. Every functor, base-arrow and filler argument is retained. No new primitive, unifier, supplied comparison or operational equality-proof payload is introduced.

Six focused controls cover mapped-arrow computations, direct and expanded composite inverse cancellation, and the established proof-time raw/stable unit readings. General lax-transfor post/left noncollapse and distinct carrier controls remain.
Legacy compatibility names and named strict_* helper interfaces remain for subsequent consumer cleanup; this checkpoint is not completion of R11.

ruleInventory.manualReview: The generalized rules stay at the existing Hom owners. Cat_cat on whole composition is a semantic discriminator. Named-owner parameters are retained where the RHS needs them; no reducible wrapper is matched. Actual input maps and selected inverse data are preserved.

attempts.reason: The consumer closure allocation-failed at 4GiB during ring-library imports after its three examples completed; a reviewed 6GiB retry passed.

Removing the wrapper-only rules exposed required represented Hom accumulation that had not yet been restored for default functors. The old positive was preserved and the computations moved to the native owners.
The restored mapped-arrow computations made two old stable-cut negatives compute. They became positives; the distinct displayed-component boundaries remain.
